title: Whistle of Death Cave Ambience
description: A very basic resource pack that adds the Whistle of Death from "Puss in Boots: The Last Wish" as a cave ambience sound.
body:
This is just a very simple, very basic resource pack that adds the Whistle of Death from _**Puss in Boots: The Last Wish**_ to the cave ambience list. A friend had the idea and I figured it would be easy to do, so I did it.

I do not claim any rights to the icon used in the resource pack nor the sound itself. They are the property of the appropriate copyright holder(s) to **_Puss in Boots: The Last Wish_** and this is strictly intended to be Fair Use.
